key: MAXWELL: \PN, right?
en: MAXWELL: \PN, right?
ja: マクスウェル: \PN、だよな?

key: Man.
en: Man.
ja: なあ。

key: I used to be king of the jungle called Reborn City.
en: I used to be king of the jungle called Reborn City.
ja: 俺は昔、リボーンシティってジャングルの王様だったんだ。

key: 'Till you showed up and dethroned me.
en: 'Till you showed up and dethroned me.
ja: お前が現れて、俺を王座から引きずり下ろすまではな。

key: Magma Gang's no more.
en: Magma Gang's no more.
ja: マグマ団はもうねえ。

key: That's your fault.
en: That's your fault.
ja: それはお前のせいだ。

key: Here I am, alone in this dump.
en: Here I am, alone in this dump.
ja: 俺はこうして、こんな掃きだめに一人ぼっちだ。

key: That's your fault, too.
en: That's your fault, too.
ja: それもお前のせいだぜ。

key: There's no glory in this.
en: There's no glory in this.
ja: これのどこにも栄光なんてねえ。

key: But...
en: But...
ja: だが……

key: I've been waiting for this.
en: I've been waiting for this.
ja: 俺はこの時をずっと待ってたんだ。

key: I hoped I'd see you again... because it's time to reclaim my fame!
en: I hoped I'd see you again... because it's time to reclaim my fame!
ja: お前にまた会えることを願ってた……名声を取り戻す時が来たんだからな!

key: \PN! Let's do this! For glory, baby!
en: \PN! Let's do this! For glory, baby!
ja: \PN!やろうぜ!栄光のためにな!

key: Still...
en: Still...
ja: マクスウェル: それでも……

key: MAXWELL: Urf... Back up. Hold on.
en: MAXWELL: Urf... Back up. Hold on.
ja: マクスウェル: ぐっ……待て。ちょっと待ってくれ。

key: Time out. Redo!
en: Time out. Redo!
ja: タイムだ。やり直しだ!

key: No? I still can't--
en: No? I still can't--
ja: だめか?まだ俺は――

key: Man, what's it take to beat you? Cheat codes?
en: Man, what's it take to beat you? Cheat codes?
ja: なあ、お前に勝つには何が必要なんだよ?チートコードか?

key: I've been lingering here in a desperate hope that if I beat you, I could rebuild my family.
en: I've been lingering here in a desperate hope that if I beat you, I could rebuild my family.
ja: お前を倒せば、俺の家族をもう一度築き直せるんじゃないかって、必死な思いでここに居座ってたんだ。

key: But it seems that won't happen.
en: But it seems that won't happen.
ja: だがどうやら、それはかなわないみたいだな。

key: Maybe it's time to move on from glory.
en: Maybe it's time to move on from glory.
ja: そろそろ栄光から先へ進む時なのかもな。

key: Take up a factory job and live a real life or something.
en: Take up a factory job and live a real life or something.
ja: 工場の仕事にでも就いて、ちゃんとした暮らしをするとかよ。

key: I've been wasting my time all along... That's humiliating.
en: I've been wasting my time all along... That's humiliating.
ja: ずっと時間を無駄にしてたってわけか……情けねえな。

key: Whatever. Take this.
en: Whatever. Take this.
ja: まあいい。これを受け取ってくれ。

key: A parting gift from a dying man.
en: A parting gift from a dying man.
ja: 死にゆく男からの、別れの贈り物さ。

key: I'll die here.
en: I'll die here.
ja: 俺はここで死ぬ。

key: And I'll be reborn, a normal person.
en: And I'll be reborn, a normal person.
ja: そして生まれ変わる、普通の人間としてな。

key: Thank you. In the end, glory was a prison.
en: Thank you. In the end, glory was a prison.
ja: ありがとうな。結局のところ、栄光ってのは独房だったんだよ。

key: ARCHER: Hello, \PN. Surprised to see you here.
en: ARCHER: Hello, \PN. Surprised to see you here.
ja: アーチャー: やあ、\PN。ここで会うとは驚いたな。

key: That is, surprised, but not disappointed.
en: That is, surprised, but not disappointed.
ja: 驚いてはいるが、失望はしていない。

key: I had hoped I might someday encounter you again.
en: I had hoped I might someday encounter you again.
ja: いつかまたお前に出会えるのではと、期待していたんだ。

key: The Aqua Gang is long kaput after that embarrassing upheaval.
en: The Aqua Gang is long kaput after that embarrassing upheaval.
ja: あの恥ずべき騒動の後、アクア団はとっくに消滅した。

key: I've been wandering. Soul-searching, you might say.
en: I've been wandering. Soul-searching, you might say.
ja: 私はさすらっていた。魂の探求とでも言えばいいか。

key: What is the answer here, I ask myself?
en: What is the answer here, I ask myself?
ja: ここでの答えは何なのか、自問していた。

key: I answer: become stronger.
en: I answer: become stronger.
ja: 答えは、こうだ。もっと強くなること。

key: Defeat \PN. Reclaim your status.
en: Defeat \PN. Reclaim your status.
ja: \PNを倒し、地位を取り戻すこと。

key: Indeed, I've been preparing for this moment. I hope you have been as well.
en: Indeed, I've been preparing for this moment. I hope you have been as well.
ja: 実際、私はこの瞬間のために準備してきた。お前も同じであることを願うよ。

key: How disappointing.
en: How disappointing.
ja: アーチャー: 実に失望させられる。

key: ARCHER: Hm. Still not enough, is it?
en: ARCHER: Hm. Still not enough, is it?
ja: アーチャー: ふむ。まだ足りないということか。

key: I am... almost relieved, to be honest.
en: I am... almost relieved, to be honest.
ja: 正直なところ……私はほとんど安心している。

key: Ambition and cunning can be two dangerous weapons, wielded together.
en: Ambition and cunning can be two dangerous weapons, wielded together.
ja: 野心とこうかつさは、共に振るえば危険な武器になり得る。

key: And yet, they are as a double-edged sword.
en: And yet, they are as a double-edged sword.
ja: だがそれは、もろ刃の剣でもある。

key: Through my own willpower and tactics, I've risen from a common street boy to a great power.
en: Through my own willpower and tactics, I've risen from a common street boy to a great power.
ja: 自らの意志と策略によって、私はただの街の少年から大いなる力へと成り上がった。

key: Alas, I am reduced to that again.
en: Alas, I am reduced to that again.
ja: だが今、私は再びそこへと引き戻されてしまった。

key: Had you not interfered, I wonder what I could have achieved. Magma was all that stood between me and my ambition.
en: Had you not interfered, I wonder what I could have achieved. Magma was all that stood between me and my ambition.
ja: お前が邪魔をしなければ、私は何を成し遂げていただろうな。マグマだけが、私の野心を阻む唯一の壁だったのだ。

key: But it seems that dream truly is ended.
en: But it seems that dream truly is ended.
ja: だがどうやら、その夢は本当に終わったようだ。

key: I am humbled, and I am not so irresponsible as to be unable to appreciate that.
en: I am humbled, and I am not so irresponsible as to be unable to appreciate that.
ja: 私は謙虚になった。それを受け止められないほど無責任な人間ではないつもりだ。

key: Please take this.
en: Please take this.
ja: これを受け取ってくれ。

key: Consider it a token of my farewell. I'm going off to die.
en: Consider it a token of my farewell. I'm going off to die.
ja: 私の別れの印だと思ってくれ。私は死にに行く。

key: ARCHER: No need to be concerned.
en: ARCHER: No need to be concerned.
ja: アーチャー: 心配は無用だ。

key: Who I was before will die, and I will be reborn, a better man.
en: Who I was before will die, and I will be reborn, a better man.
ja: これまでの私は死に、より良い男として生まれ変わる。

key: Let us see what this better man can achieve.
en: Let us see what this better man can achieve.
ja: そのより良い男が何を成し遂げられるか、見届けようじゃないか。

key: Solid, buddy! So... solid. And then break!
en: Solid, buddy! So... solid. And then break!
ja: ガチだぜ、相棒!マジで……ガチ。んで、ブレイク!

key: Awh, man, bad trip.
en: Awh, man, bad trip.
ja: ハイド: あー、参った、悪いトリップだった。

key: I need a refill.
en: I need a refill.
ja: 補充しねえと。

key: Bro, I am SO buzzed! Let's do this!
en: Bro, I am SO buzzed! Let's do this!
ja: なあ、俺マジでハイになってる!やろうぜ!

key: Wooooooah!
en: Wooooooah!
ja: ケラム: うおおおおお!

key: Broooooo...
en: Broooooo...
ja: おいおいおい……

key: Dude. Whoa. Like. Dude. Wooaaah.
en: Dude. Whoa. Like. Dude. Wooaaah.
ja: なあ。うわ。ってか。なあ。うわああ。

key: Shit, man. You wanna hit?
en: Shit, man. You wanna hit?
ja: ヤン: くそ、なあ。一発やる?

key: Nahhh, you don't want a hit.
en: Nahhh, you don't want a hit.
ja: いや～、お前はやりたくねえだろ。

key: Hey! Do you have any more "Rare Candy"?
en: Hey! Do you have any more "Rare Candy"?
ja: ねえ!「ふしぎなアメ」まだある?

key: C'mon, just a little bit!
en: C'mon, just a little bit!
ja: セリーナ: お願い、ほんの少しでいいから!

key: Hmph.
en: Hmph.
ja: ヒルダ: ふん。

key: Shit dude. I need a hit, but I don't got anymore cash.
en: Shit dude. I need a hit, but I don't got anymore cash.
ja: くそ、なあ。キメたいのに金がもうねえ。

key: Bro, I swear to God I would trade my own Pokémon for a "level up" right now. Fuck...
en: Bro, I swear to God I would trade my own Pokémon for a "level up" right now. Fuck...
ja: なあ、マジで神に誓って、今なら自分のポケモンと「レベルアップ」を交換してもいいくらいだ。クソ……

key: Ohhhh, shit, dude, you've got some, yeah? That's "Rare Candy" right there!
en: Ohhhh, shit, dude, you've got some, yeah? That's "Rare Candy" right there!
ja: うおっ、マジかよ、お前それ持ってんのか?それ「ふしぎなアメ」じゃねえか!

key: Please, dude, I'm begging you, let me have it.
en: Please, dude, I'm begging you, let me have it.
ja: 頼むよ、なあ、お願いだから、それ俺にくれよ。

key: Fuck, you can have my Pokémon if you want it. I'm more interested in BLISS than I am in battling. Please, dude.
en: Fuck, you can have my Pokémon if you want it. I'm more interested in BLISS than I am in battling. Please, dude.
ja: くそっ、欲しいなら俺のポケモンをやるよ。バトルより「至福」の方に興味があるんだ。頼むよ、なあ。

key: \PN handed over the "Rare Candy".
en: \PN handed over the "Rare Candy".
ja: \PNは「ふしぎなアメ」を渡した。

key: Bro. You are a lifesaver! Ohhh, my god...
en: Bro. You are a lifesaver! Ohhh, my god...
ja: なあ。お前は命の恩人だ!ああ、なんてこった……

key: That hits the fuckin spot man, you know what I'm sayin'? Haha.
en: That hits the fuckin spot man, you know what I'm sayin'? Haha.
ja: これがマジでたまんねえんだよな、わかるだろ?ハハ。

key: Awwwh, shit, you want this thing? Fine, take it. I really don't give a damn.
en: Awwwh, shit, you want this thing? Fine, take it. I really don't give a damn.
ja: ああ、くそ、これが欲しいのか?いいぜ、持ってけよ。マジでどうでもいいからよ。

key: Shit. Nawh, man, ain't nobody can blame you. I'd keep it if it were mine too.
en: Shit. Nawh, man, ain't nobody can blame you. I'd keep it if it were mine too.
ja: くそ。いや、なあ、誰もお前を責めやしねえよ。俺だって自分のなら手放さねえもん。

key: Shit, that was short lived... You got another?
en: Shit, that was short lived... You got another?
ja: くそ、あっという間だったな……もう一つ持ってねえか?

key: Hey, someone pass me another, yeah?
en: Hey, someone pass me another, yeah?
ja: なあ、誰かもう一つ回してくれよ?

key: BENNETT: I had a feeling you were following me.
en: BENNETT: I had a feeling you were following me.
ja: ベネット: あなたに後をつけられている気はしていました。

key: But of all people, I never expected to see you down here, \PN.
en: But of all people, I never expected to see you down here, \PN.
ja: しかし、よりにもよってこんな場所であなたに会うとは思いませんでした、\PN。

key: Then again, I suppose this isn't the sort of place someone like me would choose to be either.
en: Then again, I suppose this isn't the sort of place someone like me would choose to be either.
ja: もっとも、私のような人間が好んで来る場所でもありませんが。

key: I was asked to go get some supplies for a certain procedure, so it couldn't be helped.
en: I was asked to go get some supplies for a certain procedure, so it couldn't be helped.
ja: ある処置のための物資を取りに行くよう頼まれたもので、仕方がなかったのです。

key: Of course, they would be cross with me if someone followed me back,
en: Of course, they would be cross with me if someone followed me back,
ja: 当然、誰かに後をつけられて戻ったとなれば、皆に怒られてしまうでしょう。

key: But I must return posthaste, for Luna's sake.
en: But I must return posthaste, for Luna's sake.
ja: ですが、ルナのためにも、急いで戻らねばなりません。

key: Oh? You are also trying to help Luna?
en: Oh? You are also trying to help Luna?
ja: おや?あなたもルナを助けようとしているのですか?

key: I see.
en: I see.
ja: そうですか。

key: In that case, there should be no problem.
en: In that case, there should be no problem.
ja: それならば、問題はないでしょう。

key: The entrance to our chamber is actually hidden down here, but I'll go ahead and leave the way open for you.
en: The entrance to our chamber is actually hidden down here, but I'll go ahead and leave the way open for you.
ja: 実は私たちの部屋への入口はこの下に隠されているのですが、あなたのために道を開けておきましょう。

key: It's just right outside; you won't be able to miss it.
en: It's just right outside; you won't be able to miss it.
ja: すぐ外にありますので、見逃すことはないはずです。

key: That Arclight guy-- you know him?
en: That Arclight guy-- you know him?
ja: あのアークライトって奴、知ってるか?

key: Heard he's been poking around this parts.
en: Heard he's been poking around this parts.
ja: この辺りをうろついてるってうわさだぜ。

key: Apparently picked up some kinda ring,
en: Apparently picked up some kinda ring,
ja: 何やら指輪みたいなのを拾ったらしくてよ、

key: Realllll nice for some top-end Trainer folks.
en: Realllll nice for some top-end Trainer folks.
ja: 一流のトレーナー連中にゃたまらねえ代物らしいぜ。

key: Word is he's looking for someone to help him on a job, might be offering it as a reward.
en: Word is he's looking for someone to help him on a job, might be offering it as a reward.
ja: なんでも仕事を手伝ってくれる奴を探してて、それを報酬にするつもりらしい。

key: Out of my paygrade though, for sure.
en: Out of my paygrade though, for sure.
ja: まあ、俺には縁のねえ話だけどな。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
